verdict.rationale: Crossmint has adjacent pieces a merchant could assemble. An x402 settlement receipt is extracted from response headers to confirm onchain processing. Offramp orders can settle stablecoins to a saved bank payout method. Payments webhooks track order lifecycle and payment status. However, its agent stack is buyer/agent-side: agent checkouts are poll-only with no webhooks in v1, and order-intent accounting tracks spend for the user, not merchant reconciliation. Missing for 10: a documented merchant-side payout/settlement flow for agent-originated payments, reporting or reconciliation exports tying agent payments to merchant books, agent-checkout webhooks/events, and independent corroboration that agent payments reconcile like other channels.
